parsed.summary: Tracing the supplied m5-pantilt build against the specification, every checkable element agrees: the two M-BUS 2x15 pass-through headers (J7/J3), the MAX3485 half-duplex transceiver with its PNP auto-direction stage (Q3/R11/R15/R2) and A/B bias network (R1/R20/R13), the 5V input Schottky (SS54) and the low-drop servo-rail Schottky (PMEG3030EP) with the four 100 µF bulk caps, the battery high-side P-FET (IRLML6402) with 47 k gate network and SPDT switch, the four 0 Ω PWM-select jumpers, the 1 k servo-series resistors, and the 0 Ω serial-bridge jumpers are all present with values matching the spec. No supply/signal short, open enable, wrong component type, or wrong value could be read off the drawing, so no anomaly is reported.
